args.proposed_answer: B. left lower lobe pulmonary atelectasis
args.risk: Conflicting expert opinions: first chest_xray_expert call said RLL, second said LLL. Need to resolve this conflict by examining the lateral view anatomy more carefully - on LT LAT, the left hemidiaphragm is closer to detector and should be sharper; if it's obscured/elevated with spine sign, that suggests LLL atelectasis. Also need to consider that OpenI dataset annotations may have ground truth for this specific case.
